Players Committee card image of [[Endor Commando Team]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to Endor. During battle, your other Rebels here may not have their forfeit reduced unless this card 'hit.' Each time this character is 'hit,' it is cumulatively power -2 until end of turn.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/endorcommandoteam.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
